high.title: Ibovespa Rally Doesn't Eliminate 'Invisible Risk': Empiricus Launches New Global Allocation Portfolio to 'Shield' Portfolios
high.summary: The Ibovespa has surged 20% year-to-date, recently touching a new all-time high of 198,000 points despite geopolitical uncertainties. Key drivers include robust foreign capital inflows of R$50 billion into B3 in Q1 alone, expectations for Selic rate cuts, and potential political changes that could sustain the rally through 2026. This represents a significant shift in foreign investor sentiment toward Brazilian equities, with the strong capital inflows providing crucial support for the index's historic performance. The combination of monetary easing expectations and improved political outlook creates a favorable backdrop for Brazilian assets. However, analysts warn of "invisible risks" for investors going all-in on domestic equities, suggesting portfolio diversification remains critical. For FX traders, the sustained foreign inflows should provide structural support for BRL, while bond investors should monitor the Selic cut timeline as it will directly impact yield curves and duration strategies.

medium.title: Weekly Recommended Portfolio: 5 Stocks for Weekly Portfolio, According to Terra Investimentos
medium.summary: Terra Investimentos maintained their weekly stock selection including Azzas 2154 (AZZA3), MBRF (MBRF3), Suzano (SUZB3), Hypera (HYPE3) and Iguatemi (IGTI11). The portfolio underperformed with a -3.07% decline versus Ibovespa's -2.76% drop, with MBRF leading losses at -6.97%. However, the 12-month accumulated return shows strong outperformance at +80.54% versus Ibovespa's +44.75%, indicating solid stock-picking despite recent volatility.
